items.html: Also this is the secret of the Idra de Haazinu, page 296a: "And the illumination of the two brains is engraved in it." That is, there is in her only two Mochin, and they are drawn from the illumination of the Mochin of ZA alone; therefore it is called "the illumination of two brains," for they are light drawn from the two brains of ZA. And even though we say that these two coronets are in the Yesod, nevertheless their root and essence are dependent on the Hochma and Bina in the Netzah and Hod of ZA; only afterwards they join in the Yesod, for the need of her Daat, as we shall explain. But her main essence is only two Mochin, which are Hochma and Bina, in the Netzah and Hod of ZA, as above.
